create_sparse_pca_model: create a SparsePCA model to extract sparse components from high-dimensional data
fit_sparse_pca_model: fit a SparsePCA model on training data to learn sparse principal components
transform_data_sparse_pca: transform data using fitted SparsePCA model to project onto sparse components
inverse_transform_sparse_pca: inverse transform latent space data back to original space using SparsePCA components
create_minibatch_sparse_pca: create a MiniBatchSparsePCA model for memory-efficient sparse PCA on large datasets
